name: crew-locate-selects-employee
description: Crew cards offer a Locate button (#1422): clicking it selects that employee in the scene (the inspector shows their detail).

steps.description: Setup: a staffed site so the Crew panel has roster cards
Click Locate on a crew card (#1422) — selects that employee in the scene, so the inspector shows their detail

expect.note: Locate must select the employee in the scene, not merely move the camera

steps.description: The inspector itself carries the located employee's skills (no DETAIL hop)

expect.note: the selected employee's detail must be shown in the inspector
